expressway service area.guidance: For expressway service area, ignore amenities and human facilities. Describe only overhead layout: paved rest-area compounds, parking blocks, access ramps, roadside building clusters, road-connected open asphalt areas, and separation from the main expressway carriageway.
valid_examples: paved rest-area compound beside expressway lanes
parking blocks connected by curved access ramps
roadside building cluster surrounded by broad asphalt
open paved service zone separated from main carriageway
compact highway-side facility linked to entry and exit ramps
invalid_examples: group of service buildings with clear signage

expressway toll station.guidance: For expressway toll station, describe the overhead toll-plaza geometry: lane expansion, transverse canopy bands, repeated small booths, and road lanes passing through a checkpoint. Do not describe services or commercial facilities.
valid_examples: widened expressway segment with parallel toll lanes
transverse canopy band crossing highway lanes
repeated small booths aligned across a road corridor

airport.guidance: For airport, describe airport-scale overhead pavement layouts: runways, taxiway curves, apron fields, terminal blocks, and aircraft-sized open paved areas.
valid_examples: long runway strip connected to curved taxiways
broad apron field adjacent to terminal blocks
airport-scale pavement network with runway markings

airplane.guidance: For airplane, describe the overhead aircraft footprint: fuselage, wings, tail, and placement on airport pavement. Avoid vehicle rows, wind turbine rotors, or circular storage tank cues.
valid_examples: symmetric wing span attached to a narrow fuselage
tail-like rear shape on open airport apron
aircraft footprint larger than nearby vehicles
invalid_examples: small rectangular vehicle in parking rows

baseballfield.guidance: For baseballfield, describe overhead sports-field geometry: diamond infield, fan-shaped outfield, curved field boundary, and infield/outfield color contrast.
valid_examples: diamond infield embedded in fan-shaped outfield
curved outfield boundary around a brown infield
sports field organized around a central diamond
